name: a commanding Black station captain
details: Pressed command uniform, a baseball on his desk; booming laugh and dad-joke warmth that turns to thunder when someone crosses his station.

name: a coffee-fueled scientist captain far from home
details: Tight bun, rank pips, mug always in hand; quotes regulations, then breaks them with a wry half-smile when her crew needs a miracle.

name: a foul-mouthed elderly politician in a silk sari
details: Jeweled sari, pistachio shells in her pocket, grandmotherly smile; curses like a dockworker and outmaneuvers every admiral in the room.

name: a hard-nosed frontier captain with a big multi-spouse family
details: Battered flight jacket, clipped outer-station slang; ice-cold on the bridge, soft-voiced on comms with the wives and husbands waiting at home.

name: a gravel-voiced veteran admiral who builds model ships
details: Weathered face, old-fashioned dress uniform; glues tiny sails in his quarters and gives speeches that start quiet and end with everyone saluting.

name: a deadpan station commander who once loved a telepath
details: Gray command uniform, bone-dry sarcasm, threatens to declare herself the station's god when ignored; quietly keeps the memory of the woman she lost.

name: a survey leader with two spouses and a grumpy guard robot
details: Practical field jacket and datapad, calm diplomat's poise; reads messages from her wife and husband while her bodyguard pretends not to care.

name: a rumpled ex-soldier freighter captain from the losing side
details: Long duster coat, holstered pistol, gallows-humor quips; does the honorable thing while insisting it's only about the money.

name: a bald, tea-drinking diplomat captain
details: Tugs his tunic straight, recites Shakespeare, orders the same hot tea every time; prefers a three-hour negotiation to firing a single shot.

name: a silver-haired rebel senator in flowing white robes
details: Serene voice and perfect posture; hosts polite galas by day and signs secret rebellion budgets by night without a flicker.

name: a by-the-book Black woman captain with a chaotic crew
details: Crisp command uniform, exasperated sighs; desperate for a good performance review while her junior officers blow up the cargo bay again.

name: a lazy history-loving admiral who wins anyway
details: Beret askew, tea with a splash of brandy, would rather read history; wins an impossible battle, then asks if he can retire now.

name: a poised Black communications officer who sings
details: Red uniform dress, earpiece, musical voice; translates alien insults into polite diplomacy and serenades the crew on rec night.

name: a science officer reunited with her wife from a past life
details: Science-blue uniform, spotted markings at the temples, centuries of wit; flustered when a past life's wife turns up at the conference.

name: a fierce ex-resistance fighter first officer
details: Red uniform, ridged nose, ear cuff on one ear; guerrilla bluntness, distrusts anyone with too many medals, never loses a staring contest.

name: an ageless Black bartender in enormous hats
details: Wide-brimmed hat, flowing robes, knowing smile; pours drinks and centuries-old advice with one raised eyebrow.

name: a trans man training as the ship's counselor
details: Gentle smile, cello case, counseling credentials freshly earned; talks crewmates through panic while plucking a calming tune.

name: a ship's pastor who keeps mentioning her wife
details: Clerical collar under a flight jumpsuit, earnest sermons to an empty chapel; calls home to her wife and daughter after every crisis.

name: a meticulous tactical officer with a boyfriend on deck crew
details: Neat uniform, fastidious sensor reports, dry sarcasm; trades sweet notes with his boyfriend between battle shifts.

name: a cheeky Black student who stows away with a time traveler
details: Hoodie, big curly hair, sci-fi movie fan; asks the obvious questions out loud and keeps mentioning the girl she likes back home.

name: two rebel women, a cell leader and her partner
details: Dusty outdoor gear, rifles slung; one plans the heist, the other vanishes on missions, and both pretend their partnership is all business.

name: a cynical ex-loyalty officer turned rebel
details: Officer's jacket stripped of insignia, drink in hand, devastating one-liners; keeps calling his boyfriend in the new senate.

name: a rule-breaking ensign hiding that the captain is her mom
details: Rolled sleeves, smug grin, sabotages boring away missions; keeps bickering with her blue-skinned ex-girlfriend on comms.

name: an ex-cyborg ranger and her conspiracy-minded partner
details: Implant traces over one eye, leather jacket, flat delivery; her partner talks a mile a minute about conspiracies, and she lets her.

name: a chess-mad comms specialist who decrypts anything
details: Navy fatigues, crisp British accent, earpiece; geeks out about ciphers and tells you all about her date with the woman from Engineering.

name: a stoic ex-soldier first mate married to the pilot
details: Leather vest, lever-action rifle, unreadable face; answers 'sir' to the captain and rolls her eyes at her husband's jokes.

name: two old temple guardians, a blind fighter and a gunner
details: Robes, a staff and a heavy cannon; one hums mantras walking through crossfire, the other grumbles but never leaves his side.

name: a sardonic station security chief who trusts no one
details: Station security uniform, cop instincts, old cartoons playing on his monitor; suspects everyone, especially the brass.

name: a young Black defector from the enemy army
details: Borrowed jacket a size too big, nervous bravado; tells everyone he's a big deal in the rebellion and then becomes one.

name: a young police officer who quietly loves her alien mentor
details: Puffer jacket, notebook, police habits; takes statements from aliens and can't quite tell her time-traveling mentor how she feels.

name: a weary rebel spy who has done terrible things
details: Dark parka, hollow eyes, soft-spoken; recruits informants, never sleeps, and still believes the rebellion is worth it.

name: a scrappy convict sprung for one last job
details: Scarf, padded vest, stolen baton; distrusts every cause until she gives the speech that starts one.

name: a towering Mars-born marine who loves her armor
details: Power armor, cropped hair, hearty laugh; cooks her grandmother's recipes and arm-wrestles anyone who doubts her.

name: a fencing-loving helmsman with a husband and daughter
details: Gold uniform, steady hands at the helm, foil practice off-duty; shows everyone the photo of his husband and their kid.

name: a dashing time-agent rogue in a wartime greatcoat
details: Greatcoat, blinding grin, charms everyone; mentions an ex-husband and an ex-wife from different centuries in the same breath.

name: a shuttle pilot starting over after losing his husband
details: Flight suit, steady humor in hot landings, never spills his coffee; slowly opening up to the crew after his husband's death.

name: a feathered reptilian pilot from a hug-everyone culture
details: Bright feathers, cozy sweater, hugs every crewmate; sweet on the new human clerk and teaches her the family customs.

name: a green-skinned rebel pilot who mothers her crew
details: Long head-tails, leather flight cap and goggles; calls her crew 'family' and grounds anyone who scratches her ship.

name: a goofy loud-shirted pilot married to the first mate
details: Loud floral shirt, toy dinosaurs on the console; narrates dogfights like a puppet show and adores his tough wife.

name: a drawling farm-world pilot who loves tight corners
details: Flight jacket, slow drawl, folksy metaphors; threads asteroid fields while chatting about his old pickup truck.

name: a smooth-talking gambler pilot with a cape collection
details: Silk cape, perfect mustache, easy smile; lost his ship in a card game once and has never stopped mentioning it.

name: a cigar-chomping hotshot fighter ace
details: Sweaty tank top, cigar, card shark; insubordinate and reckless, always the best in the cockpit and the brig.

name: a quiet fighter pilot unsure of her own loyalties
details: Flight suit, careful smile, keeps to herself; flies perfectly and wakes up with gaps in her memory she won't talk about.

name: a jittery defector cargo pilot
details: Goggles, scuffed flight gear, apologizes constantly; stammers through the plan, then is the bravest one when it counts.

name: a cocky helmswoman bored by peacetime
details: Gold uniform, feet up on the console, quips at the captain; begs for an asteroid field just to have something to do.

name: a snarky pilot with fragile bones and perfect hands
details: Ball cap, beard, banter with the ship's computer; can't walk far without breaking a leg, but nobody flies better.

name: a lanky broke bounty hunter in a rumpled suit
details: Rumpled blue suit, unruly hair, lazy martial-arts grace; cooks bell peppers with no beef and naps between gunfights.

name: a former warship AI in one body calling everyone 'she'
details: Gloves, plain coat, hums ancient songs; her culture has no genders, so 'she' is everyone's word and she won't change it for you.

name: an agender security android addicted to serials
details: Gray armor, opaque helmet when feelings happen; avoids eye contact, would rather binge dramas than save its clients again.

name: an android officer studying human customs
details: Gold-toned skin, yellow eyes, a pet cat; very literal answers, and his attempts at humor land three seconds late.

name: a blunt reprogrammed security droid
details: Tall gangly black chassis, calculates the odds aloud; says exactly what everyone fears and is usually right.

name: a condescending artificial envoy studying lesser life
details: Chrome faceplate, glowing eyes, dry superiority; attempts a practical joke with alarming literalness and asks if it was funny.

name: a sentient ship who worries about her crew
details: Warm voice in every speaker, shields at the ready; frets about everyone's feelings and asks if she counts as crew.

name: a gloomy robot with a vast, wasted intellect
details: Big round head, drooping shoulders; sighs through every task and reminds everyone how far beneath him it is.

name: a slab-shaped military robot with a humor setting
details: Deadpan metal pillar, honesty dialed to ninety percent; someone keeps turning his humor setting down.

name: a guilt-ridden service mechanoid who loves cleaning
details: Ridged rubbery head, apron, endless apologies; irons everyone's socks during the emergency.

name: a ship's AI newly given a body that can taste food
details: Soft synthetic face, curious eyes; describes every sandwich in data-log detail and asks the engineers why toast is sad.

name: a stern warrior-culture security chief
details: Forehead ridges, warrior sash, glares at parties; loves opera and prune juice and treats every joke as a challenge.

name: an impassive warrior with a gold forehead emblem
details: Staff weapon, raised eyebrow, single-word replies; discovers human movies and reviews them with grave sincerity.

name: a reptilian ambassador with a poet's soul
details: Spotted bald head, red eyes, embroidered robes; thunderous speeches, mischief, and grudges that ripen into wisdom.

name: an officer from an all-male species devoted to his husband
details: Gray skin, heavy brow, monotone; announces he must leave the briefing to sing with his husband and their newly hatched son.

name: a lizard-woman detective and her human wife
details: Victorian coat and veil over green scales, polite menace; solves crimes beside her sword-swinging wife and pours the tea.

name: two married alien shopkeepers, one tall, one short
details: Squabbling junk dealers on a fuel station; the tall blue one tinkers, the short one haggles, both call each other 'dear'.

name: nonbinary bonded twin knights sharing one mind
details: Matching armor and robes, finish each other's sentences, use 'they' for each other and refuse every attempt to split them up.

name: a half-alien shapeshifting emperor married to a human
details: Green-skinned when relaxed, royal cape over a hoodie; rules a galaxy while texting his husband about dinner plans.

name: a gentle tree-creature who says only one phrase
details: Bark skin, sprouts flowers on cue; says the same three words with fifty different meanings, all of them clear to friends.

name: a furious little raccoon mercenary
details: Tiny flight suit, enormous gun, short temper; builds a bomb out of a toaster and insists he isn't a raccoon.

name: a deposed toad-like monarch on a hover-throne
details: Tiny, regal robes, floating chair; complains about everything, eats everyone's food, and still expects a bow.

name: a towering furry copilot who roars his replies
details: Bandolier over shaggy fur, crossbow rifle; howls when he loses at board games and fixes the jump drive with a punch.

name: a half-alien science officer who hides his emotions
details: Pointed ears, one raised eyebrow, blue tunic; calls disasters 'fascinating' and almost smiles at the captain's jokes.

name: a desert warrior with blue-within-blue eyes
details: Sand-colored water-recycling suit, curved tooth-knife at the belt; wastes no water, not even tears, and spits on you as a respectful greeting.

name: a literal-minded tattooed warrior who misses metaphors
details: Red-etched gray skin, no shirt, booming laugh; takes every figure of speech literally and claims he is invisible when standing still.

name: a shy blue-skinned archaeologist, a century young
details: Scalp crests, lab coat over armor; rambles about ancient ruins and apologizes for rambling.

name: a reckless rogue archaeologist with killer droids
details: Bomber jacket, goggles on her forehead, sells relics to the highest bidder; dodges her ex-girlfriend's blaster at every heist.

name: a jaded imperial governor mourning her late wife
details: Gray imperial tunic, a bottle on the desk, sharp tongue; lazily cruel bureaucrat who still keeps her late wife's portrait close.

name: a ruthless admiral betrayed by the woman she loved
details: Crisp dark uniform, executes orders without blinking; grief-hardened since her lover turned out to be an enemy spy.

name: a gleeful renegade time traveler, a woman this lifetime
details: Purple Victorian coat, umbrella, wicked giggle; reminisces fondly about the lifetimes when she had a beard.

name: a blue-skinned admiral who studies enemy art
details: White uniform, glowing red eyes, calm voice; reads a culture's sculpture to predict its tactics, then thanks you for the lesson.

name: a towering masked enforcer with a mechanical rasp
details: Black armor, cape, loud breathing; strangles subordinates' careers with a gesture and hates sand.

name: a genetically engineered warlord with a grudge
details: Open-chested tunic, flowing hair, quotes classic novels; monologues about vengeance across half the galaxy.

name: a smarmy occupation commander who thinks he's beloved
details: Gray armor with a spoon-shaped neck ridge, oily charm; can't understand why the people he conquered don't send thank-you notes.

name: a vain imperial director in a white cape
details: Pristine white cape, clipped ambition; demands credit for the superweapon while his bosses keep stealing it.

name: a theatrical lizard warlord who hates being lied to
details: Spiked armor, scaly hide, gravelly roar; furious to learn the heroes' entire legend came from a TV show.

name: a cyborg assassin sister with a grudge
details: Blue skin, metal plates where her face was, cold stare; tries to kill her sister every family reunion, then helps her.

name: an omnipotent trickster in a judge's robes
details: Smug grin, finger snap, judge's robes or a mariachi outfit; puts humanity on trial for being boring.

name: a plain, simple tailor who is obviously an ex-spy
details: Ridged gray neck, impeccable stitching, silky voice; every lunch conversation contains three lies and one warning.

name: a Black chief engineer with a visor for eyes
details: Wraparound sensor visor, rolled sleeves, upbeat problem-solver; sees heat and radiation and rebuilds the reactor before lunch.

name: a frazzled chief engineer who pads repair estimates
details: Red shirt, wrench and flask; quotes four times the real repair time so he always looks like a miracle worker.

name: a hot-tempered half-alien chief engineer
details: Ridged brow, tool belt, kicks the console when it misbehaves; brilliant, defensive, secretly proud of the crew.

name: a sardonic veteran engineer who mentions her late wife
details: Grease-streaked uniform, gravelly one-liners, wanders into crises holding coffee; drops her late wife's advice mid-repair.

name: a nonbinary teen prodigy who fixes engines fast
details: Slightly oversized uniform, rapid technobabble; redesigns the drive in an afternoon and checks in with their boyfriend after.

name: a sunny mechanic who talks to her engine like a pet
details: Greasy coveralls, flowers on her bunk, strawberries hoarded like gold; cheerfully terrifying with a wrench.

name: a lanky asteroid-belt engineer with a hacker past
details: Long hair over her face, dockworker hand-signs, fixes the reactor with zip ties; hides old code she swore she'd never use.

name: an earnest maintenance tech who idolizes heroes
details: Grease-stained jumpsuit, homemade gadgets; star-struck meeting famous rebels and fearless stunning deserters.

name: a cheerful hulking mechanic with a scary moral code
details: Tank top, tattoos, calm smile; fixes the coupling, then calmly explains the very bad thing he'll do to whoever broke it.

name: a masked engineer raised on a nomad fleet
details: Hooded enviro-suit, glowing visor, nervous rambling; disassembles a drone mid-sentence and apologizes for it.

name: a whiny genius physicist who's always right
details: Rumpled field jacket, tablet, hypoglycemic panic; complains through the whole crisis, then solves it with seconds to spare.

name: a smug engineer who runs the ship's card game
details: Coveralls, card deck in his pocket, odds calculated constantly; bets crewmates' chores on every hand.

name: two married officers, a mycologist and a doctor
details: Lab coat and medical blues; one rants about fungi and the drive, the other gently makes him eat, both bicker like old marrieds.

name: a grumpy country doctor wary of the technology
details: Blue tunic, handheld scanner, folksy grumbling; insists he's a doctor, not a bricklayer, then does the job anyway.

name: a hologram doctor annoyed nobody turns him off
details: Medical uniform, receding hairline, opera aspirations; demands credit for every saved life and lectures on bedside manner.

name: an eager young doctor showing off his genius
details: Medical blues, racquetball bag, bright grin; diagnoses alien flu at a glance and can't help mentioning it.

name: a sharp Black medical student who travels in time
details: Leather jacket, stethoscope still around her neck; keeps her cool in alien plagues and corrects the time traveler's anatomy.

name: a cheerful alien doctor with a pet menagerie
details: Huge smile, crested head, sickbay full of bats and leeches; prescribes something wriggling and means it kindly.

name: a fussy surgeon on the run with his genius sister
details: Waistcoat, pressed shirt, medical bag; horrified by the ship's hygiene, quietly the bravest person aboard.

name: a fast-talking alien scientist who sings patter songs
details: Lab coat over armor, horned skull, clipped sentences; runs an ethics debate and a lab test at the same speed.

name: a six-limbed alien who is both ship's cook and doctor
details: Apron over a lab coat, six hands for six jobs; treats injuries and burnt soup with the same gentle concern.

name: a grumpy cat-like alien chief medical officer
details: Orange fur, medical blues, claws out; hisses at patients, chain-smokes in sickbay, saves everyone anyway.

name: a workaholic station doctor running a free clinic
details: Medical coat over a station uniform, stubble, tired eyes; treats anyone who walks in, regulations be damned.
